name: codex-context-compacto
description: Keep selected conversation history around a summarized middle in a new, resumable Codex session.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve head and tail context across compaction.
interface.longDescription: Preview retained history, summarize the middle, and create a fresh Codex session without modifying the original. Includes a manual skill and an opt-in PreCompact hook.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Compacto to preview and compact this session, keeping the original intact.
